# Links and Formatting Fixture

Standard link to [Documentation](https://example.com/docs).

Text with **bold phrasing**, *italic phrasing*, and ***bold and italic nested***.

Underscores inside words like file_name_test and variable_name should not be italics.

Asterisks inside math like 2*3*4 should be handled cleanly.

A link with formatting inside: [**Bold Link Title**](https://example.com).
